secrets.name: COMMUNICATION_SERVICES__ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Azure Communication Services access key (Azure portal > Communication Services > your resource > Keys). Required to place or receive calls.

secrets.name: COMMUNICATION_SERVICES__PHONE_NUMBER
secrets.description: E.164 phone number purchased in Azure Communication Services, e.g. +33612345678

secrets.name: COMMUNICATION_SERVICES__RESOURCE_ID
secrets.description: Azure resource ID of the Communication Services resource (used as JWT audience for call callbacks).

secrets.name: COGNITIVE_SERVICE__ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure AI Services multi-service account endpoint, e.g. https://<resource>.cognitiveservices.azure.com (speech-to-text / text-to-speech).

secrets.name: COGNITIVE_SERVICE__REGION
secrets.description: Azure region of the AI Services resource, e.g. swedencentral.

secrets.name: DATABASE__COSMOS_DB__ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure Cosmos DB account URI, e.g. https://<account>.documents.azure.com — needed for call history and the /report web pages.

secrets.name: LLM__FAST__ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure OpenAI deployment URL for the fast model (gpt-4.1-nano), e.g. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<deployment>

secrets.name: LLM__SLOW__ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure OpenAI deployment URL for the main model (gpt-4.1), e.g. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<deployment>

secrets.name: QUEUE__ACCOUNT_URL
secrets.description: Azure Storage account queue endpoint, e.g. https://<account>.queue.core.windows.net — carries incoming call, SMS and post-call events.

secrets.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
secrets.description: Service principal tenant ID used by DefaultAzureCredential for Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI and Storage access.

secrets.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Service principal client ID used by DefaultAzureCredential (grant it Cosmos DB, Cognitive Services and Storage roles).

secrets.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Service principal client secret used by DefaultAzureCredential.
